excerpt: For petrinet, an 8-byte data SPM yields 82.5% of original WCET, 32 bytes yields 71.4%, and fitting all global data yields 69.7%. For fsm, 8 bytes yields 93.5% and 256 bytes or larger yields 78.6%. With the real TriCore 40 kB SPM, average WCET reaches 79.8% of original WCET.
overview: The data scratchpad evidence shows that WCET improvements come from selecting high-value variables, not from changing instruction sequences. It also marks the architecture-specific scope: the reported gains rely on TriCore memory characteristics and on benchmarks with static or global data.
title: Data SPM Results
